AN INDEPENDENT ENGINEERING STUDY ↗
THE ENGINEERING EDIT / 001

A machine,
made understandable.

Qvist_designs' independent 2026 concept is presented in 16 illustrative groups. The shape comes from the source model, with display cuts in the joined bodywork. It is not Ferrari SF-26 CAD or a complete internal assembly model.

Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, and move the disassembly slider to look inside. Select components on the car or in the list to learn about them. The slider also works with your keyboard’s arrow keys.
